controls.refusal: H@1: pad:group5 -- NO PREIMAGE: the pad half of this combination is not reachable from the opened columns (the residual is not divisible by the sampled nodes' vanishing polynomial)
controls.what: one OPENED COLUMN entry of this commitment moved by one
controls.why: the row's pad polynomial is the interpolant through the d sampled nodes, so moving one opened value moves that row's pad by a Lagrange basis polynomial of degree d-1; every combination that reads the row then has a pad residual that Z_S (degree d) does not divide

controls.refusal: A@1: group 0 -- NO PREIMAGE: the published claim values and the public row constraints cannot be met inside the kernel of the group-vector constraint
controls.what: one GROUP VECTOR entry moved by one, at a MESSAGE position the group's column key really reads
controls.why: the anchor pair absorbs the moved entry, so the group VECTOR is still reproduced -- and then the verifier's own group identity <v_g, cw> = sum lambda*value no longer holds, and no correction inside the kernel of the vector constraint can change that sum.  This is the control that tests the gate's OWN criterion: a channel with no preimage must be reported as having none

controls.refusal: H@1: pad:group0 -- NO PREIMAGE: the pad half of this combination is not reachable from the opened columns (the residual is not divisible by the sampled nodes' vanishing polynomial)
controls.what: one GROUP VECTOR entry moved by one, at the first PAD coefficient
controls.why: the pads are already fixed at the d sampled nodes by the opened columns, so the only freedom left in the combination is a multiple of Z_S; a constant added to the residual is not one

controls.refusal: H@1: row 0 -- NO PREIMAGE: 254 pad symbols cannot meet 255 distinct opened columns (the interpolant of the required values has degree 254)
controls.what: the commitment modelled with 254 pad symbols against 255 distinct opened columns
controls.why: the required pad values at d distinct nodes determine an interpolant of degree d-1; a commitment with fewer than d pad symbols cannot carry it, and the refusal names the degree

controls.what: the reserved mask row 139 of A@1 (group 0) and row 138 of H@1 (group 0) declared the SAME blinding unknown
controls.why: both per-commitment preimages exist, and they force DIFFERENT values on the shared unknown: no JOINT preimage exists.  This is the case a per-commitment acceptance cannot see, and it is why the run gate's joint figures (ruling R-3) are not evidence of independent blinding
controls.why_forced: each is the anchor of a group whose only non-data support is that pair and whose correction kernel is empty, so with the data at zero its value at every message position is the unique solution of an invertible 2x2 system

before_projection.refusal: H@1: group 8 -- NO PREIMAGE: the published claim values and the public row constraints cannot be met inside the kernel of the group-vector constraint

identities.identity: the LogUp sum claim: the view determines sum over data rows of rw[i] * (row sum), and the published value is 0

controls.what: a SECOND fixed input -- a public, deterministic, in-range pseudorandom one from the seed 'zk60-privacy-gate/fixed-input/v1' -- on every data row of H@1, before and after projection onto the identity the view discloses
controls.why: H's disclosed dimension of 2 is exactly this identity.  A fixed input off it has NO preimage -- the disclosed dimension shows up as a REFUSAL, not as a number -- and the same input projected onto it has one, verified entry by entry.  The all-zero input is ON the identity because the published LogUp sum is zero, which is why round 7's honest case is feasible at all

what: for every PCS commitment of the run -- A and H included -- prover blinding that reproduces the captured view under the ALL-ZERO hidden input, solved exactly over Fp and then verified by recomputing the view entry by entry
what_it_does_not_show: nothing about the LAW of the blinding: a preimage EXISTS, which is not the statement that the honest prover's randomness is uniform on the fibre (that is the lemma's job)
nothing about the masking commitment M's own rows (the CFS channel)
nothing about an UNOPENED Merkle leaf, which no preimage can reproduce (M-2, M-3)
nothing at the 125M shape and nothing nonlinear
